title: critoniopsis peruviana
intro: Critoniopsis peruviana, commonly known as Peruvian critoniopsis, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family, characterized by its flowering tops and leaves that are used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Critoniopsis peruviana include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestive health due to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
